watch.stakes_why: A plausible 0.2pp move flips the inflation voter from peak to contraction — the heaviest single input to the needle can change here.

watch.stakes_why: Neither branch can move a voter off its current read.
watch.setup: Unemployment holds at 3.8% with a Sahm gap of +0.10pp, with the Fed priced 68% to hike / 32% to hold — this print decides whether the hawkish case keeps its room.

a.label: Strong (payrolls above trend, unemployment holds)
a.implies: Fed keeps room to be hawkish

b.label: Weak (payrolls below trend or unemployment ticks up)
